hazards.control: Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Drillout bottomhole assembly (motor and mill)
function: The tools on the end of the coil for a plug drillout: coil connector, dual check valves, disconnect, circulation sub, positive-displacement motor, and the mill that grinds the composite plugs.

tabs.overview: Fluid pumped down the coil drives the motor, which turns the mill; weight is applied through the injector. Each plug takes minutes when the mill is sharp and returns are good; cuttings are carried to surface in the annulus. Dual check valves keep well pressure out of the coil; the disconnect lets the coil be freed if the BHA sticks.
tabs.engineering: Motor sized to the coil flow; mill type chosen for composite plugs and the casing; agitators or extended-reach tools help the coil reach the toe.
tabs.connections: Coil connector to the coil; mill on the motor.
tabs.safety: Check valves are the barrier inside the coil; the disconnect is the last resort before cutting the coil.
tabs.evidence: Public coiled tubing pressure control guide (S24), API RP 16ST and API RP 5C7 scope (S23, S26), field practice (S9).
tabs.operations: Made up on the ground, tested, run through the stack.
tabs.failure_modes: Motor stall, mill wear, stuck BHA, check valve failure.
